_comment: Asset manifest for tools/blender/scene_kit.py. One entry per game-ready mesh.
Fields, all optional except source and out:
source      path to the authored art, relative to the repo root (.obj/.fbx/.glb)
textures    directory of downscaled maps to repoint images at before export
exaggerate  vertical multiplier applied in source proportions, before fit.
A terrain scan flatter than 0.2 relief-to-width needs this to read
fit         {axis, size} uniform scale so that axis spans size studs
decimate    target triangle count before tiling
tile        [nx, ny] bisect grid; every tile must clear 10k triangles
up          which Blender axis is up after import: x|y|z (default z). It is
normalised onto Blender Z before export, because export_yup maps
Blender Z to glTF Y and Roblox reads glTF as Y-up.

jetpack.description: Titan Cameraman jetpack pack, worn on the torso

jumppad.description: UE4-jam jump pad, sits on the floor at the launch position
